build.sourceWorktree: dirty; sourceHead identifies HEAD but the build includes local modifications

sourceSnapshot.algorithm: SHA-256 over sorted relative file paths, NUL separators, and raw file bytes for src/, public/, index.html, vite.config.ts, package manifests, TypeScript configs, and scripts/build.mjs.

method.gzip: Node gzipSync level 9 per file, matching scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs.
method.brotli: Node brotliCompressSync quality 11 per file; estimate only, no deployed server encoding was measured.
method.routeGraph: Sum of manifest entry plus transitive static-import JS/CSS files for index.html and route entry; shared files counted once. Dynamic imports from the route entry are excluded.
method.limitations: Build artifact/manifest estimate only. Does not measure HTML request timing, server headers/encoding, actual browser cache or transfer, parse/execute cost, runtime CWV, backend latency, or production RUM.
